name: Guffie

nadir.desc: The property consists of a white single-story primary residence with a white roof|A detached white structure is located near the main house|A large open grassy yard surrounds the buildings|Dense mature evergreen trees line the road frontage and portions of the property edges|The driveway is hidden from the nadir view and from street view, will be difficult to see due to the trees|Outdoor items and equipment are present in the yard|Fencing encloses portions of the lot.

alpha.desc: The front of the property is heavily screened by dense mature evergreen trees along the road|The white residence and detached structure are partially visible through or behind the tree line|Driveway access point is obscured by the nature of the trees|Open grassy areas extend behind the trees toward the buildings.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the white house and detached structure partially visible behind dense evergreen trees|Open grassy areas extend along this side|A road runs along this side of the property but no visible driveway or path extends from it|Trees continue along the perimeter near the road.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back of the white house and detached structure|A large open grassy yard extends behind the buildings|Dense evergreen trees border portions of the property|Outdoor items are present in the yard.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the white house and detached structure|Open grassy areas and dense evergreen trees continue along this side|A walking path connects to the two structures|The roads are visible beyond the tree line|Fencing is present along portions of the perimeter.

considerations: Vehicle access from the main road is screened by dense mature evergreen trees along the frontage. While no driveway is visible from Huckleberry Loop, the area is flat and potentially accessible. Open grassy areas surround the residence and detached structure and provide space for movement once on the property. Dense tree coverage along the road may limit initial visibility of the structures from the street. A detached white structure is located near the main house. Outdoor items are present in the yard. Fencing encloses portions of the property. The property is located in a rural wooded setting with neighboring structures nearby.
